exact_vouch.rule: an exact-tier arm other than the cell's stock arm serves the EXACT word only on a stack listed in the cell's vouched_on[arm] (the running stack word the caller passes: <card>:torch<ver>+cu<NNN>/<triton>/cueq<ver|->); on any other stack, or when the stack is not given, the face names the floor (the cell's stock arm) with the reason 'exact vouch not recorded on <stack>'; fast / big / faithful words are tolerance-class and unaffected; a row word is the caller's explicit choice and is served as asked

exactln.evidence: bitwise F.layer_norm (fp32 | bf16) and the autocast statement (+ cast) for widen / bf16o at C 64/128/256/384/768, affine both|neither: kernel-level checks on both cards of each stack (incl. the shipped CUBIN bundles: 40/40 per stack)

exactln:widen.evidence: as exactln (widen = the autocast statement, bf16o = + .to(bfloat16))

exactln:triton.evidence: bitwise F.layer_norm at C 64 / 128 on both cards of each stack

row_rule: cells are chosen by the call's ROW count (numel / C): within the family the smallest cell measured at >= rows serves (size_measured), above the largest measured rows the largest serves flagged beyond_measured; rows per cell = pair N^2 | pairbwd N^2 | atom 8N | dit 5N | single N | lnlinear N at the cell's N

first_call.method: first call of the row in a fresh process after a CUDA warm-up op (seconds, host wall clock incl. the row's imports, module load / JIT compile and the first launch) and the steady per-call ms after it (median of 5); 'cold' = empty Triton cache dir (TRITON_CACHE_DIR=<new>), 'warm' = a second process on the same cache dir; exactln rows: 'cold'/'warm' serve the shipped CUBIN bundle (no compile), 'compile' = OPT_CORE_EXACTLN_PREBUILT=0 with an empty NVRTC disk cache (the path before the bundle); sizes: LN pair C=384 N=800 (640000 rows; exactln:triton at C=128), APB DiT S=5 N=800 16x48 bf16 (fp32 for fpf_apb:fp16 / dit_exact) and pairformer S=1 N=384 16x24

exactln_bundle.what: prebuilt/exactln_fwd-sm90.cubin + -sm80.cubin (40 instantiations each: forms fp32/bf16/bf16w/bf16o x C 64/128/256/384/768 x affine both|neither), built once by NVRTC 12.6; per stack: 'verify' = bundle served (compiles 0), 'jit' = OPT_CORE_EXACTLN_PREBUILT=0; output digests of all 40 keys identical between the two and across stacks; every output bitwise the ATen statement

big_rule: big = the fast winner unless its recorded peak (peak_mib) exceeds the stock arm's by more than 2%% + 16 MiB; then the fastest fast-admissible arm, the stock arm included, whose peak does not exceed that bound; no peak record for either -> big == fast

tier_floors.schema: tier_floors/v1: rows-count floors below which a TIER word (never a row word) serves the statement row by name, from an engine's in-model measurement where the cells' per-kernel numbers cannot see the call's surroundings; each floor names its form / affine / timing scope and source

rows.source: kit table: the no-affine (AdaLN) LayerNorm in eager mode -- the fused rows measured faster than the statement only at >= 327680 rows in-model; below it the statement row serves by name

kit table: the exact row served only at >= 65536 rows (one 256-token pair tensor), ATen below; the cells AGREE by measurement for the fp32 form (exactln x0.44-0.81 of ATen below 65536 rows on both cards, so the exact word already resolves ATen there) -- recorded for the record, enforced by the cells themselves; NOT applied to the bf16 x / fp32-parameter forms, where exactln:widen measures x1.2-1.4 of the fp32 statement at 400-16384 rows
